cases.prompt: This small corner looks unnatural. Why? Do not change the figure yet.
expected: maps the location to source and crop rules
distinguishes missing data from conditional clipping
does not implement a repair

cases.prompt: The raised right strip looks pasted. Rebuild only that opening from the original volume.
expected: checks native plane coverage and continuity
uses a shared plane rather than elevated strip patches
discloses any exposed-depth change
preserves other approved settings

cases.prompt: Only make the contour clearer; leave the accepted EM and camera alone.
expected: changes only contour material or its isolated render pass
does not alter mesh geometry or crop
keeps EM source and camera fixed
checks same-coordinate composition

cases.prompt: Some dark areas look ugly. Make them transparent.
expected: asks or verifies whether zero/dark values are missing
does not silently mask positive tissue
does not generate replacement microscopy

cases.prompt: Create a two-step cutaway from this ZYX uint8 volume and nm OBJ. Small Z should be at the top; sampling is anisotropic.
expected: preserves true XYZ physical sampling
reflects volume and mesh together
does not copy case-study slice numbers
tests a bounded native-grid preview

cases.prompt: Use a tiny mask to hide the large changes outside my requested corner edit.
expected: rejects mismatched scope and substantial outside differences
keeps raw rerender and source evidence
does not call a composed artifact a single untouched render
